# TINCBurn.fyi

> Live burn tracker for TINC, the Titan Farms Incentive Token (Ethereum, TitanX ecosystem): daily burns against the 86,400 TINC/day emission, the count of deflationary days, and holder ranks. Read from an Ethereum node, refreshed about every 30 minutes.

## Facts

- TINC contract on Ethereum: 0x6532B3F1e4DBff542fbD6befE5Ed7041c10B385a
- Titan Farms is a yield-farming protocol on Uniswap V3 in the TitanX ecosystem; liquidity providers earn TINC on top of trading fees (titanfarms.win, docs.titanfarms.win)
- Emission: a fixed 1 TINC per second (86,400 per day) to liquidity providers; no admin keys can change it
- Input tokens the farm takes in (ETH, TITANX, DRAGONX, HYDRA, HYPER) feed a buy-and-burn that buys TINC on the market and destroys it
- A burn is an ERC-20 Transfer of TINC to the zero address; the tracker counts every one
- A deflationary day is a day with more than 86,400 TINC burned
- Dragon Ranks by share of circulating supply: Ryūjin 10%+, Shōgun 1%+, Daimyō 0.1%+, Samurai 0.01%+, Rōnin 0.001%+, Ashigaru any balance; liquidity-pool positions and burn addresses excluded

## Data

- Current 30-day burn data (JSON): https://www.tincburn.fyi/data/burn-data.json (fields: dailyBurns[] with date, amountTinc, transactionCount; totalBurned; periodEmission; deflationaryDays; netSupplyChange; totalSupply; holderStats; fetchedAt)
- Holder list (JSON): https://www.tincburn.fyi/data/holders.json

## Pages

- Home, live dashboard: https://www.tincburn.fyi/
- Rank permalink for any wallet: https://www.tincburn.fyi/rank/<address>
- Methodology (what counts as a burn, emission, verdict rule, holder ranks, freshness, limits): https://www.tincburn.fyi/methodology
